summary: Iteration 3 backend testing complete. All 23 pytest tests pass (100%), including 9 new tests covering: GET /api/schedule/summary shape+totals+personil access, PATCH/GET settings.min_active_per_shift, conflict 409 detail with correct {date,shift='Pagi',remaining=2,minimum=3} and pending status/schedule unchanged, force=true approval flipping cell to 'Cuti Tahunan' + audit row, non-conflict path when min lowered to 2, Penugasan bypasses conflict check, and rejection unaffected by conflict. No regressions from iter 1 & 2.
critical_code_review_comments: Conflict-check loop performs one find_one + one count_documents per day in [start,end]; for long ranges this is O(2*days) roundtrips. Consider aggregating with $group over the date range for performance on multi-week absences.
Coercion `int(settings_doc.get('min_active_per_shift', 3) or 3)` silently swallows falsy 0. If admin ever wants min=0, they cannot set it. Prefer explicit None check.

SettingsIn strips None but keeps 0 for min_active_per_shift — but the update handler filters out all None with `v is not None`, so setting min_active_per_shift=None won't be accepted; that's fine but there is no way to remove the field. Minor.
server.py now ~750 lines — over the 700-line split threshold; recommend splitting into routers/schedule.py, routers/requests.py, routers/settings.py.
CORS_ORIGINS='*' with allow_credentials=True (unchanged from iter 2) — browsers will reject credentialed cross-origin requests. Should be explicit origins if auth cookies are ever used.
